title: Nvidia robotics engineer quits after Huang's exit, questions company's future | 'I have not felt heard' | Inshorts

Nvidia robotics engineer quits after Huang's exit, questions company's future 
 Menu English हिन्दी Categories For the best experience use inshorts app on your smartphone Nvidia robotics engineer quits after Huang's exit, questions company's future
 short by Jessica Rajan / 04:16 pm on Sunday, 15 November 2026 Nvidia robotics engineer Darrell Dai has announced his resignation following former CEO Jensen Huang's exit, citing disappointment over the leadership change. Dai said the lack of an explanation had left him uncertain about the company's future direction and whether employees' views were being considered. He added that the decision made him feel excluded from a major organisational change. read more at Moneycontrol Inshorts Pte. Ltd.
